acceptance_tests: The Task 047 proposal, predecessor VST3 contracts, exact processor seams, source closures, reuse fingerprints, and JUCE manifest authenticate before implementation.
Only 32000, 44100, 48000, 88200, 96000, 176400, and 192000 Hz prepare; 48000 Hz bypasses with zero latency and every other declared rate reports deterministic positive latency.
For absolute host frame H, cumulative source frames equal ceil(H*48000/F_host), event mappings are monotone and never early, and results are independent of callback partitioning.
Both existing 48000-Hz processor suites retain exact direct-Core PCM, event, state, reset, and instance parity.
At every other declared rate both processors emit finite bounded nonzero stereo output with preserved source progress, event ordering, reset behavior, and instance isolation.
The converter meets the frozen DC, 1-kHz, 18-kHz passband, 23-kHz stopband, latency, and partition tolerances, while the unfiltered comparator fails the alias threshold.
Repeated non-48000-Hz processing owns no heap allocation or lock; unsupported rates and layouts and callbacks above 8192 frames fail to exact silence with bounded diagnostics.
Both actual Release modules scan, instantiate, report latency, round-trip unchanged state, create and destroy editors, and render at 44100, 48000, and 96000 Hz.
Affected Instrument Lab, Tide Pit, and Pamplist regressions, applicable sanitizers, Schuss current, selected compatibility, and one relocated reproduction per VST3 pass after freeze.
Results keep source, host structural, host signal, target build, Live, real-time, connected-device, listening, distribution, and production evidence independent.
